title: Winamp aims for a comeback with a new music player powered by Deezer
slides: Winamp is back—but can it reclaim your playlist?
Its new player runs on Deezer’s streaming catalog.
The old MP3 king now offers no local file support.
You get Deezer’s library through Winamp’s nostalgic skin.
Test the beta yourself before judging the reboot.
thread_text:
Winamp is back. Can it win?

But there’s a catch: the new beta supports zero local files.

Why kill the MP3 player?

The old king now runs entirely on Deezer’s streaming catalog.

Nostalgia sells — but at what cost?

You get Deezer’s library wrapped in Winamp’s classic skin.

The twist: no offline freedom.

Your old .mp3 collection is locked out. Streaming only.

Test the beta today.

Download it now and see: does the skin alone justify the switch?

instagram.caption:
Your old .mp3 collection won’t play on the new Winamp. It ditched local files entirely. 🎵

The beta runs only on Deezer’s streaming catalog. Winamp is now a skin over a subscription service, not a player for your own music.

If you create playlists from personal files, you can’t migrate them—only Deezer’s library works.

Will you switch your workflow for a nostalgic interface? 🎧 Testing the beta now costs your offline freedom.
